notes: Session max_tokens is verified in the isolated SQLite record. Missing server slot samples remain null.
Provider usage is current request usage, not accumulated CLI totals.
Ledger [0,0,1,0] proves one threshold compaction before the short probe and excludes capacity recovery.
8K growth reserve is an explicit planning assumption, not an upper bound for tools or images.
Previous 32K output qualification is independent, not evidence of 32K generation after compaction.
16K-growth sensitivity at actual pre-probe usage rejects 18/36 rows in six cases. These are arithmetic failures, not observed model crashes.
Reported CLI version is verified; this is not cryptographic source/binary provenance.
Session Vision capability flags are metadata only; no images were submitted.
Selected pre/post current usage matches and internally additive ledger rows are checked; accumulated CLI/session totals are not equated with current usage.
Earlier revisions without system/additional-config guard fields are distinguished from later executions; absence of the system config and inherited overrides was independently checked.
